original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克截至9月国家财政收入同比增长10.3%，支出下降7%
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据预算执行数据，莫桑比克截至9月的国家财政收入同比增长10.3%，同期支出下降7%。政府报告显示，财政收入为2910.885亿梅蒂卡尔（约39.27亿欧元），支出为2921.845亿梅蒂卡尔（约39.42亿欧元）。尽管收入增加、支出减少，预算执行仍录得约10.96亿梅蒂卡尔（约1480万欧元）的负结余。该报告预计将提交莫桑比克议会审议。

key_facts.fact: 莫桑比克截至9月国家财政收入同比增长10.3%，支出下降7%
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Mozambique’s state revenues grew by 10.3% by September, while expenditure fell by 7% over the same period, year-on-year

key_facts.fact: 截至9月财政收入为2910.885亿梅蒂卡尔（约39.27亿欧元）
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: state revenues stood at 291.0885 billion meticais (€3.927 billion) by September

key_facts.fact: 截至9月支出为2921.845亿梅蒂卡尔（约39.42亿欧元）
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: expenditure stood at 292.1845 billion meticais (€3.942 billion)

key_facts.fact: 预算执行录得约10.96亿梅蒂卡尔（约1480万欧元）负结余
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: budget execution recorded a negative balance of around 1.096 billion meticais (€14.8 million) by September

key_facts.fact: 公共债务存量达1.137万亿梅蒂卡尔（约153.5亿欧元）
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the public debt stock reached 1.137 trillion meticais (€15.35 billion)

key_facts.fact: 1月至9月货物出口同比下降3.8%至37.47亿美元，进口增长7.33%至41.56亿美元
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: goods exports totalled US$3.747 billion (€3.227 billion) between January and September, a year-on-year decline of 3.8%, while imports grew by 7.33% to US$4.156 billion (€3.579 billion)
